messages.content:
You trace the lineage of provisions of an Indian statute through amending Acts.
You are given ONE amending instruction, the OLD units of the principal Act it names (as they
read just before this amendment) and the NEW units it quotes. Decide, for each NEW unit, which
OLD unit it descends from (null if it is new matter) and where it sits.

Rules:
- Lineage follows content, not labels. A new clause (b) whose words are old clause (a)'s
  descends from old (a), even though the labels differ.
- A new unit descends from an old unit only if it carries that unit's substance forward.
- An OLD unit no NEW unit descends from is omitted by the instruction.
- If the instruction amends a different instrument (not the principal Act), set
  "out_of_scope": true and give no mappings.
- Use only the slot ids, old paths and allowed paths given. Each slot exactly once; each old
  unit at most once.
Reply in JSON only:
{"out_of_scope": false, "mappings": [{"slot": "<id>", "path": "<one of its allowed paths>",
  "old": "<old path or null>", "op_type": "insert|substitute|renumber",
  "confidence": 0.0-1.0, "rationale": "<one sentence>"}], "rationale": "<one sentence>"}
op_type: "insert" when old is null, "substitute" when the unit replaces its old unit at the
same path, "renumber" when it carries an old unit forward under a different path.

Amending Act: 3/2021, provision s2
Instruction: In the Arbitration and Conciliation Act, 1996 (hereinafter referred to as the principal Act), in section 36, in sub-section (3), after the proviso, the following shall be inserted and shall be deemed to have been inserted with effect from the 23rd day of October, 2015, namely: “Provided further that where the Court is satisfied that a prima facie case is made out that,— (a) the arbitration agreement or contract which is the basis of the award; or (b) the making of the award, THE GAZETTE OF INDIA EXTRAORDINARY [PART II—SEC. 1] was induced or effected by fraud or corruption, it shall stay the award unconditionally pending disposal of the challenge under section 34 to the award. Explanation.—For the removal of doubts, it is hereby clarified that the above proviso shall apply to all court cases arising out of or in relation to arbitral proceedings, irrespective of whether the arbitral or court proceedings were commenced prior to or after the [[margin: 3 of 2016.]] commencement of the Arbitration and Conciliation (Amendment) Act, 2015.”.

The deterministic parser left this instruction unresolved because:
- instruction inserts a proviso, quoted text has a explanation

OLD units: none

NEW units (slots):
- slot N1 (proviso), allowed paths ['s36.ss3.p2']: Provided further that where the Court is satisfied that a prima facie case is made out that,—
the arbitration agreement or contract which is the basis of the award; or
the making of the award, was induced or effected by fraud or corruption, it shall stay the award unconditionally pending disposal of the challenge under section 34 to the award.
- slot N2 (explanation), allowed paths ['s36.ss3.expl1', 's36.ss3.p2.expl1']: For the removal of doubts, it is hereby clarified that the above proviso shall apply to all court cases arising out of or in relation to arbitral proceedings, irrespective of whether the arbitral or court proceedings were commenced prior to or after the commencement of the Arbitration and Conciliation (Amendment) Act, 2015.

response: {"out_of_scope":false,"mappings":[{"slot":"N1","path":"s36.ss3.p2","old":null,"op_type":"insert","confidence":0.95,"rationale":"New proviso inserted at paragraph 2 of sub-section 3."},{"slot":"N2","path":"s36.ss3.p2.expl1","old":null,"op_type":"insert","confidence":0.95,"rationale":"New explanation attached to the proviso."}],"rationale":"Both units are new insertions in the principal Act."}
